title: Print Technician — Career Roadmap
summary: A Print Technician prepares, operates and maintains printing equipment, checks print quality, manages inks and substrates, and troubleshoots production issues across commercial printing, packaging, labels, publishing and digital print services.

facts.Current degree: Diploma in Printing Technology / Packaging Technology

blocks.label: Recommended route
blocks.text: Class 10 followed by a relevant diploma; some programmes accept Class 12 applicants.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Computer Applications and basic design.

blocks.label: Entrance exams
blocks.text: State polytechnic admission tests or institution-specific selection; verify current notifications.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Offset and digital printing, colour reproduction, paper, inks, packaging and finishing.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Attention to detail, mechanical aptitude, colour awareness, computer literacy and safety.

items.text: Diploma in Printing Technology → Press operations, pre-press, print production and quality control.
Diploma in Printing & Packaging Technology → Packaging print, labels, cartons and production workflows.
Diploma in Packaging Technology → Packaging materials, converting, print coordination and quality checks.
Diploma in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering → Printing-machine maintenance and industrial equipment support.
Diploma in Graphic Design / Pre-Press → Artwork preparation, page layout, colour management and digital production.

blocks.label: The exact curriculum matters
blocks.text: a printing diploma generally provides the most direct preparation for press-side technician work.
